answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: each new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N real reputations, and every caught fake is replayed on the ledger. The lotus of honest standing compounds, the river of attestations carries weight forward, and the kernel of every vouch is public, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
